# Sigil 1.13.0-beta.3 (Experimental)

- Adds the Relic Dice Ritual: an original bone-and-stone tray, portal, impact, settling dice and illustrated result plaque.
- Adds a globally selectable Relic skin for all supported dice, including percentile rolls.
- Commits secure roll outcomes before animation; visible faces, history and fallback use the same result.
- Adds event-driven ritual and collision sounds with mute, volume and Fast controls.
- Supports skipping animation, reduced motion and a 2D fallback when graphics are unavailable.

This is an Experimental prerelease. Stable distribution remains unchanged.
